Row.Text: A skilled administrator focused on economic and military governance.
Reduces unit maintenance fees by 5 [ICON_Gold] Gold, but reduces [ICON_Amenities] Amenities by 5 as increased military spending strains the budget.
Increases [ICON_Gold] Gold output of all cities by 100%, but reduces [ICON_Amenities] Amenities by 10 as industrial growth creates urban strain.
Increases [ICON_Production] Production output of all cities by 100%, but reduces [ICON_Amenities] Amenities by 15 as citizens experience fatigue from increased work demands.
Grants the empire free Radio technology, and unlocks a project where the capital can be moved to another city.
Increases [ICON_Food] Food output of all cities by 100%, but reduces [ICON_Favor] Diplomatic Favor per turn by 1 in all cities due to trade policy shifts.
Grants the empire free Telecommunications technology, and unlocks a project for emergency powers that can be enacted across the empire.
When this project is completed, the capital is relocated to the city that has completed this project.
When this project is completed, free units spawn for all eligible districts in the empire. Reduces all city output by 50% for the next 10 turns as stabilization efforts take priority.
The capital was relocated to {CityName} as part of a strategic administrative restructuring.
